issues.detail: The Greek text 'απεκριθησαν αυτω' means 'they answered HIM'. The Vietnamese translation omits the object 'him', making it sound like they were just stating a title rather than responding to a specific question/address.
The Greek 'εγω ειμι' is a simple present 'I am'. The Vietnamese 'Chính Ta đây!' (It is I / Here I am) adds an emphatic 'Chính' and a locative sense 'đây' not present in the Greek text.
